name: sc2-asset-catalog-monorepo
description: The SC2 asset catalog, the finders and their shared kit, as npm workspaces.

scripts.lint: npm run build -w @team-antioch/sc2-asset-catalog && npm run build -w @team-antioch/sc2-finder-kit && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @team-antioch/sc2-asset-catalog && npm run build -w @team-antioch/sc2-finder-kit && npm test --workspaces
